timing.caveat: One sequential pair under other concurrent work; total 1.2365x monotonic improvement is not an isolated factorization speedup. J assembly code is identical yet varied by 6.94 s. Both wall and monotonic clocks are retained and disagree substantially.
timing.counterfactual: Eliminating the entire baseline rank/factor/solve phase would save about 2.97 of 49.44 s (6.0%). Factorization alone cannot remove the dominant assembly cost.

remaining: Dominant centered J assembly has not been optimized or benchmarked in a new revision.
Helper malformed string API issue remains in preserved prototype.
Candidate-specific free-flight/feedback/branch and actual WASM coverage remains required.
Exact-rcond null currently breaks web/main.js numeric formatting; UI/serialization tests need explicit lower-bound semantics.
One selected paired case is not general validation and does not resolve the aero26 physical mesh/experimental limitations.

synthetic.classification: The only failed check is string matrix -> TypeError rather than AnalysisError. Numeric production derivative assembly cannot create this input, but the helper API needs controlled validation before promotion.

limitations: One selected128-panel locked straight-wing zero-control state and two parameter columns only. No general correctness, free-flight/feedback coverage, WASM portability, or release claim.

Baseline/candidate run sequentially once each with BLAS/OMP thread1. Other authorized jobs may overlap and the host wall clock can jump; keep both clocks and phase measurements. No repeats solely to improve timing.
The centered residual assembly is unchanged and still scales with all state columns. This prototype targets dense rank/factor costs; it does not implement structured residual-Jacobian assembly.
Automatic fast-path promotion still requires threshold/fallback/malformed/scaling and all supported physical-path coverage plus certificate-aware UI rendering.

invariants: Keep every original +/- state and parameter sample, step, full row and branch check.
Never set IterationFields to a lagged geometry phase.

Unsupported supports, branch context or malformed layout use original individual columns.

Compare full raw matrices, all parameter partials, complete states and outputs; retain step-refinement studies and all branch checks.
No use of an iteration matrix or stale Newton factor as an exact derivative tangent.
Preserve the existing centered path as the automatic fallback for unsupported or unresolved cases.

differences: Explicitly avoids the lagged Newton context; complete moving induced fields and branch checks are retained.
Geometry defaults to spatial rotation increments; equilibrium derivatives perturb absolute network rotation coordinates.
Uses fourth-order residual differences, refined field differences, direct mechanics/circulation/local-rate derivatives and compatible section rows.

mechanisms.role: Complete descriptor A/M tangent used by modes and Bode

differences: Only difference_order 1 and 4 are currently accepted; no original two-point centered mode exists.
Local frozen-field partials are combined with full moving-field chain-rule terms; substituting only local partials would omit physical coupling.

Even adding a two-point stencil does not automatically equal a finite difference of the complete nonlinear residual: chain-rule/direct derivatives and finite differences have distinct truncation/roundoff.
Direct geometry uses analytic partials; fallback geometry has refinement and storage budgets. Full-entry paired comparisons and step-refinement evidence are mandatory for any adaptation.
mechanisms.role: Complete local plus moving-field geometry reconstruction

differences: TangentInfluences already has bounded material, exact geometry-state, local-row and exact pair caches.
Current derivative assembler does not establish its own TangentInfluences context, unlike network and dynamic tangent builders.
GeometryStencil reconstructs individual geometry samples before any nonlocal field evaluation; it does not authorize grouping full residuals with incomplete supports.
Reusing caches still needs entry-for-entry derivative-pair validation, condition invalidation, failure cleanup and budget controls in this specific call path.
mechanisms.role: Useful exact-computation reuse primitives, not a replacement Jacobian

proposed_validation_before_any_promotion: Freeze each new isolated revision and plan; preserve current candidate, paired report and synthetic failure.
Synthetic helper API correction for string/object inputs gets a targeted regression in the new revision; do not overwrite the 25/26 outcome.
Force fast path and fallback in existing rigid/flexible, structural-output, free-flight and feedback derivative tests; do not rely on tests that only exercise default dense mode.

Compare complete raw J/scales/partials entry-for-entry for the exact-cache/coloring proposal; compare all physical arrays at 2e-8 absolute plus 2e-8 relative and recompute original full Jdx+Rp residual <=1e-8.

Exercise moved geometry, rates, Mach/ground, controls, Fourier circulation, body/engine layouts, applied/point loads, large rotations, hinge/wire/engine branch transitions, interrupted calls and exhausted caches.
Use a saved-equilibrium restore only in any next authorized paired physical benchmark; one baseline/candidate pair, bounded/reaped children, no timing-only retries.
Run the final chosen code in actual local Pyodide; native synthetic factor success is not WASM coverage.

Handle nullable exact-rcond in web/main.js and tests explicitly: render a labeled lower bound and preserve legacy exact-rcond assertions where dense SVD is used. Do not substitute the bound under the old exact label.
After coverage, intended production policy is an automatic supported fast path with exact original fallback; isolated opt-in is not the final user-facing design.
